pending.body: Add deserialization aliases for the renamed snapshot chemistry fields. `TankSnapshot` now only declares the new names such as `tan_mg_n_per_l`, `nitrite_mg_n_per_l`, `nitrate_mg_n_per_l`, `phosphate_mg_p_per_l`, and `estimated_conductivity_us_cm` (`crates/tank_core/src/types/snapshot.rs:9-28`), but the TUI still parses `/snapshot`, `/time/step`, and `/load` responses straight into `TankSnapshot` (`crates/tank_tui/src/api_client.rs:28-46`, `crates/tank_tui/src/api_client.rs:70-79`). That means a newer client can no longer talk to an older API server that still emits only `tan_mg_l`/`nitrite_mg_l`/etc. even though this bead explicitly called out backward compatibility for API consumers. Add `#[serde(alias = ...)]` coverage or an equivalent compatibility DTO so version-skewed clients do not fail to deserialize snapshots.

Make the overview screen label the conductivity/TDS values as estimates, not definitive readings. The main summary line still renders `7-ion TDS ... Cond ...` in `crates/tank_tui/src/screens/overview.rs:53-55`, even though the underlying fields are `estimated_tds_7_ion_mg_per_l` and `estimated_conductivity_us_cm`. The chemistry screen was updated correctly, but the overview screen is still user-facing output that can read like true TDS/conductivity rather than a 7-ion proxy. Rename that line to something like `Est. TDS (7-ion)` and `Est. conductivity` there as well.
